title: Smart Spending: Birthday Party Planner
learningGoals: Plan a multi-item budget for an event
Compare unit prices to find the best deal
Trade off between luxury items and core needs

teachingScript.teacherLine: Planning a party is fun, but it can be expensive! A budget helps you have a great time without spending too much.

data.title: The Party Budget
points: Goal: Plan a party for 10 friends.

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's use the Birthday Party Planner. Drag the items you want into your list and stay under ₹2,000!

questionPool.questionText: If a pack of 5 balloons is ₹50 and a pack of 10 is ₹80, which one is cheaper per balloon?
questionPool.hint: Divide the price by the number of balloons.
